section.content: 本实用新型公开一种锂离子电池，包括壳体和盖板，壳体包括均呈矩形的两个第一面、一个第二面及一个第三面，两个第一面相对设置，第二面与第三面的一端连接并相互垂直，第二面与第三面均设置在两个第一面之间并均与两个第一面连接，盖板呈L型，包括相互垂直的第一分段和第二分段，盖板与壳体连接并封堵壳体的开口。本实用新型的锂离子电池的壳体具有较大尺寸的开口，相较于常规的电芯入壳时只能在一个方向维度上移动芯包，本实用新型实施例的壳体允许芯包在两个方向维度上进行调整，降低了芯包在入壳时的难度，减小了芯包被壳体挫伤的概率。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery, including casing and apron, the casing is including two first faces, a second face and a third face that all are the rectangle, and two first faces set up relatively, and the second face is connected and mutually perpendicular with the trilateral one end of third, and the second face all sets up between two first faces and all is connected with two first faces with the third, and the apron is the L type, including mutually perpendicular's first segmentation and second segmentation, the apron is connected and the opening of shutoff casing with the casing. The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery's casing has great large size opening, can only remove the core package in an orientation dimension when going into the shell in traditional electric core relatively, the utility model discloses the casing allows the core package to adjust in two orientation dimensions, has reduced the degree of difficulty of core package when going into the shell, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by the casing.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a technical field is made to the battery, especially relates to a lithium ion battery of shell is gone into to easy core package.

Background

The existing lithium battery comprises two types of winding type core packages and laminated type core packages, and for the lithium battery adopting the winding type core packages, the core packages are easily contused by a shell of the battery in the traditional shell entering process.

In addition, in order to reduce the rock of the core bag in the shell and avoid unnecessary capacity loss, the opening of the shell at present is usually only slightly larger than the size of the core bag, so that the core bag needs to be accurately positioned when entering the shell, the edge of the shell is prevented from contusing the core bag, and the difficulty of entering the shell is large.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a lithium ion battery has great large size opening on its casing, and when the core package adopts the mode of side income shell to assemble, it is less to go into the shell degree of difficulty, and the core package is difficult to be contorted by the shell of battery.

To achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical proposal:

the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, includes casing and apron, the casing is including two first faces, a second face and a third face that all are the rectangle, two the first face sets up relatively, the second face with the one end of third face is connected and mutually perpendicular, the second face with the third face all sets up two between the first face and all with two the first face is connected, the apron is the L type, including mutually perpendicular's first segmentation and second segmentation, the apron with the casing is connected and the closing cap the opening of casing.

As an optimized scheme of the utility model, at least one through-hole has been seted up on the apron, all be provided with in the through-hole and converge the fluid, converge the fluid and be connected with the inside core package electricity of battery, the through-hole both sides all be provided with one with the insulating pad of apron laminating, one side that the through-hole is located the battery inside is provided with the fixed shim, converge fluidic one end and pass two trompil on the insulating pad reaches the through-hole and with the fixed shim is connected.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the size of the opening is smaller than the size of the through hole.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the insulating spacer is bonded to the cover plate.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the fluid collecting body is riveted to the fixing pad.

As a preferred scheme of the utility model, the quantity of through-hole is two, two the through-hole is all seted up on the first segmentation or all set up on the second segmentation.

As a preferred scheme of the utility model, the quantity of through-hole is two, one the through-hole is seted up on the first segmentation, another the through-hole is seted up on the second segmentation.

As an optimized proposal of the utility model, the cover plate or the shell is provided with a liquid injection hole.

As an optimized proposal of the utility model, a sealing nail is arranged on the liquid injection hole.

As an optimized scheme of the utility model, the casing with apron laser welding.

The utility model has the advantages that:

the utility model discloses a lithium ion battery's casing has great large size opening, can only remove the core package in an orientation dimension when going into the shell in traditional electric core relatively, the utility model discloses the casing allows the core package to adjust in two orientation dimensions, has reduced the degree of difficulty of core package when going into the shell, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by the casing.

Drawings

Fig. 1 is an exploded view of a lithium ion battery according to an embodiment of the present invention;

fig. 2 is a side view of fig. 1.

In the figure:

1. a housing; 11. a first side; 12. a second face; 13. a third surface; 2. a cover plate; 21. a first segment; 211. a through hole; 212. a liquid injection hole; 22. a second section; 31. a sink fluid; 32. an insulating spacer; 321. opening a hole; 33. fixing a gasket; 4. and (5) sealing the nail.

Detailed Description

The technical solution of the present invention is further explained by the following embodiments with reference to the accompanying drawings.

In the present disclosure, unless expressly stated or limited otherwise, the first feature "on" or "under" the second feature may comprise direct contact between the first and second features, or may comprise contact between the first and second features not directly. Also, the word "over" a first feature or feature in a second feature may include the word "over" or "over" the second feature, or may simply indicate that the first feature is at a higher level than the second feature. A first feature "under" a second feature may include a first feature that is directly under and obliquely under the second feature, or may simply mean that the first feature is at a lesser elevation than the second feature.

Furthermore, the terms "first", "second" and "first" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance or implicitly indicating the number of technical features indicated. Thus, a feature defined as "first" or "second" may explicitly or implicitly include one or more of that feature.

As shown in fig. 1 and fig. 2, the lithium ion battery of the present embodiment includes a housing 1 and a cover plate 2, the housing 1 includes two first surfaces 11, a second surface 12 and a third surface 13, the two first surfaces 11 are disposed oppositely, the second surface 12 is connected with one end of the third surface 13 and is perpendicular to each other, the second surface 12 and the third surface 13 are disposed between the two first surfaces 11 and are connected with the two first surfaces 11, the cover plate 2 is L-shaped and includes a first segment 21 and a second segment 22, and the cover plate 2 is connected with the housing 1 and seals the opening of the housing 1. The rectangle includes a rectangle and a square.

The lithium ion battery's of this embodiment casing 1 has the opening of great size, can only remove the core package in a direction dimension when going into the shell in traditional electric core relatively, the utility model discloses a casing 1 allows the core package to adjust in two direction dimensions, has reduced the degree of difficulty of core package when going into the shell, has reduced the probability that the core package was contused by casing 1.

Preferably, two through holes 211 are formed in the cover plate 2, a fluid collecting body 31 is arranged in each through hole 211, the fluid collecting body 31 is electrically connected with a core package (not shown in the figure) inside the battery, two sides of each through hole 211 are respectively provided with an insulating gasket 32 attached to the cover plate 2, one side of each through hole 211 inside the battery is provided with a fixing gasket 33, and one end of the fluid collecting body 31 penetrates through the open holes 321 in the two insulating gaskets 32 and the through holes 211 and is connected with the fixing gaskets 33. The two insulating gaskets 32 isolate the bus bar 31 from the cover plate 2 so as to realize the insulation of the bus bar 31 and the cover plate 2, the fixing gasket 33 is connected with the bus bar 31 so as to fix the bus bar 31, and the rotation of the bus bar 31 can be effectively prevented by the friction force between the fixing gasket 33 and the insulating gasket 32 positioned in the battery. One sink 31 is connected to the positive lugs of the core pack as a positive terminal and the other sink 31 is connected to the negative lugs of the core pack as a negative terminal.

In another embodiment, only one through hole 211 is formed in the cover plate 2, so that only one current collector 31 needs to be arranged, the current collector 31 is electrically connected with one pole of the core pack inside the battery, and the other pole of the core pack is electrically connected with the shell 1 (the positive pole lug or the negative pole lug of the core pack is welded on the shell 1), so that the cost of the battery can be further reduced. In this embodiment, an insulating film may be further coated on a part of the surface of the case 1, so that a specific region of the case 1, which is not coated by the insulating film, functions as a battery terminal, and the battery is prevented from being easily short-circuited due to the whole exposed surface of the case 1.

Further, the size of the opening 321 is smaller than that of the through hole 211, so that the sidewall of the bus bar 31 does not contact with the wall of the through hole 211 to achieve insulation.

In some embodiments, the insulating gasket 32 is bonded to the cover plate 2, and although the insulating gasket 32 may be fixed by friction force due to being pressed against the cover plate 2 by the bus bar 31 or the fixing gasket 33, if the connection between the bus bar 31 and the fixing gasket 33 is loosened, the insulating gasket 32 is easily loosened, and the insulating gasket 32 may be displaced from its original position to cause the sidewall of the bus bar 31 to contact with the through hole 211, thereby causing insulation failure. The insulating gasket 32 is bonded to the cover plate 2, so that the insulating gasket 32 is more firmly fixed, and the sealing performance between the insulating gasket 32 and the cover plate 2 is improved to some extent.

Preferably, the bus bar 31 is riveted to the fixing washer 33. Since the insulating gasket 32 is usually made of plastic or other soft materials, it is not preferable to fix the current collector 31 and the fixing gasket 33 by welding, and the riveting connection can not generate heat which can burn the insulating gasket 32, but can press the insulating gasket 32 on the cover plate 2, thereby improving the sealing performance of the battery.

In the embodiment shown in fig. 1 and 2, two through holes 211 are opened on the first segment 21, and are suitable for assembling the core pack located on the same side as the positive and negative electrode tabs. Of course, both through holes 211 may also open on the second section 22.

In other embodiments, one through hole 211 is formed on the first segment 21, and the other through hole 211 is formed on the second segment 22, which is suitable for assembling the core package having a certain included angle with the positive and negative electrode ears.

Preferably, the lid 2 further has a liquid injection hole 212. Further, the liquid injection hole 212 is formed in a position opposite to the extending direction of the tab of the core bag, so that the core bag can be directly soaked by the electrolyte, and the soaking speed of the core bag by the electrolyte is increased. Of course, the case 1 may be perforated to allow the electrolyte to be injected.

Furthermore, a sealing nail 4 is arranged on the liquid injection hole 212, and the sealing nail 4 is used for plugging the liquid injection hole 212 after liquid injection, so as to prevent the electrolyte from leaking.

In other embodiments, the liquid injection hole 212 functions as a through hole 211 formed in the cover plate 2, so that the number of holes to be punched can be reduced, which is beneficial to simplifying the process, improving the production efficiency, and reducing the cost.

Preferably, the case 1 is laser welded to the lid plate 2. The distance between the to-be-welded gaps between the shell 1 and the cover plate 2 is long, corners exist, and laser welding has the advantages of being high in precision and efficiency and capable of meeting welding requirements between the shell 1 and the cover plate 2.
